  <script>
    (function () {
      // <details> already opens/closes natively with zero JS (see moreMenu() in
      // renderTopBar.ts) -- this is pure enhancement: closing sibling menus when one
      // opens, and closing on a click outside. Neither running is fine, just less polished.
      var moreEls = document.querySelectorAll('.topbar-more');
      moreEls.forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener('toggle', function () {
          if (!el.open) return;
          moreEls.forEach(function (other) {
            if (other !== el && other.open) other.removeAttribute('open');
          });
        });
      });
      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        moreEls.forEach(function (el) {
          if (el.open && !el.contains(e.target)) el.removeAttribute('open');
        });
      });
    })();

    // Swap the guest "Login" button for a username link, read from the stored JWT --
    // build time has no visitor, so the markup above always starts as guest. Reads the
    // token's payload only (no signature verification, same as the SPA's own optimistic
    // display of gachaTracker.user.username) purely to decide what to show; every real API
    // call still verifies the signature server-side, so a tampered token can't do more here
    // than make this box show a wrong name. Kept out of the "More" toggle IIFE above since a
    // JSON.parse/localStorage failure here (private browsing, a malformed or stale token)
    // must never take the nav dropdowns down with it.
    (function () {
      function base64UrlDecode(str) {
        str = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
        while (str.length % 4) str += '=';
        return decodeURIComponent(
          atob(str).split('').map(function (c) {
            return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
          }).join('')
        );
      }
      try {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('usertoken');
        if (!token) return;
        var parts = token.split('.');
        if (parts.length < 2) return;
        var payload = JSON.parse(base64UrlDecode(parts[1]));
        var username = payload && payload.username;
        if (!username || typeof username !== 'string') return;
        if (username.length > 20) username = username.slice(0, 20);

        var authEl = document.querySelector('.topbar-auth');
        if (!authEl) return;
        var wrap = document.createElement('div');
        wrap.className = 'topbar-user';
        var link = document.createElement('a');
        link.className = 'topbar-username';
        link.href = '/profile';
        link.textContent = username; // textContent, not innerHTML -- the decoded payload is unverified
        wrap.appendChild(link);
        authEl.innerHTML = '';
        authEl.appendChild(wrap);
      } catch (e) {
        // Malformed token or localStorage unavailable -- leave the guest "Login" button as-is.
      }
    })();
    
    (function () {
      fetch('/news/latest.json', { cache: 'no-store' })
        .then(function (res) { return res.ok ? res.json() : null; })
        .then(function (latest) {
          if (!latest || typeof latest.id !== 'number') return;
          var seen = Number(localStorage.getItem('news_last_seen_id') || 0);
          if (latest.id <= seen) return;
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-news-dot]').forEach(function (el) {
            el.style.display = '';
          });
        })
        .catch(function () { /* offline, or the file doesn't exist yet -- leave dots hidden */ });
    })();
  </script>

    document.querySelectorAll('.show-more-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const bannerSlug = btn.getAttribute('data-banner-slug');
        const hiddenDiv = document.querySelector(`.hidden-entities[data-banner-slug="${bannerSlug}"]`);

          btn.textContent = isVisible ? `and ${hiddenDiv.querySelectorAll('a').length} more` : 'show less';

      });
